audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is ModExp gas calculation safe from integer overflow?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): ModExp precompile gas calculation is an execution layer feature. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement the ModExp precompile or its gas computation. No ModExp-related code found in the Prysm codebase.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are EIP-7825 and EIP-7883 activated simultaneously at Fusaka fork?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): EIP-7825 (transaction gas cap) and EIP-7883 (ModExp gas repricing) are execution layer EIPs. Prysm is a consensus layer client. No references to EIP-7825 or EIP-7883 found in the Prysm codebase. Prysm's Fusaka support covers CL features only (data columns syncing, ENR fields).

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Do MEV-Boost relays validate gas cap for submitted blocks?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): MEV-Boost relay gas cap validation is performed by the relay infrastructure, not the consensus client. Prysm integrates with MEV-Boost via the Builder API but does not implement relay-side validation of EL gas caps. The DefaultBuilderGasLimit in Prysm is a CL-side builder configuration parameter, not an EL validation check.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does block validation catch private channel txpool bypasses?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): Transaction pool (txpool) management and private channel (Flashbots Protect) validation are execution layer features. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement txpool validation or private transaction channels. The only txpool reference in Prysm is a CLI flag passed to the geth execution client in end-to-end tests.

audit_items.title: Verify Pre-Condition: Is ceiling division used in multiplication_complexity for words?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): The multiplication_complexity function and ceiling division for word calculation are part of the ModExp precompile gas computation in the execution layer. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement ModExp or its gas calculation.

audit_items.title: Verify Post-Condition: Is iteration_count = bit_length(exponent) - 1 for small non-zero exponents?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): The iteration_count and exponent bit_length computation are part of the ModExp precompile gas formula in the execution layer. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement this logic.

audit_items.title: Verify Post-Condition: Is bit_length of top 32 bytes computed correctly for large exponents?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): The bit_length computation for large exponents in ModExp gas calculation is an execution layer feature. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement ModExp precompile logic.

audit_items.title: Verify Invariant: Is ModExp gas computation using only integer arithmetic (no floating-point)?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): ModExp gas computation and its integer arithmetic invariant are execution layer concerns. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement ModExp gas computation.

audit_items.title: Verify Pre-Condition: Is gas cap check on raw tx.gasLimit, not derived values?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): Transaction gas cap validation on raw tx.gasLimit is performed in the execution layer txpool. Prysm is a consensus layer client. While Prysm has GasLimit fields in execution payload protobuf messages, these are received from the execution client via Engine API and are not validated for EIP-7825 gas cap compliance by the CL.

audit_items.title: Verify Invariant: Is ModExp gas cost monotonically non-decreasing with input size?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): ModExp gas cost monotonicity is an execution layer precompile property. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement the ModExp gas formula.

audit_items.title: Verify Invariant: Is EIP-7883 gas cost >= EIP-2565 gas cost for all inputs?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): EIP-7883 vs EIP-2565 gas cost comparison is an execution layer concern (ModExp precompile repricing). Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement either EIP's gas formula.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is ECDSA signature recovery correctly deriving sender addresses?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): ECDSA signature recovery for transaction sender address derivation (secp256k1_recover + keccak256) is an execution layer feature. Prysm uses ECDSA only for P2P networking (libp2p key generation), not for EL transaction sender recovery. No recover_sender or keccak256-based address derivation found in Prysm.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is the ECDSA r-component range validation enforced?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): ECDSA r-component range validation (0 < r < SECP256K1N) is an execution layer transaction validation feature. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not validate EL transaction signatures. No SECP256K1N constant or r-value validation found in Prysm.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is EIP-2 low-s normalization enforced?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): EIP-2 low-s normalization enforcement is an execution layer transaction validation feature to prevent transaction malleability. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not validate EL transaction signatures or enforce EIP-2 constraints.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are transaction type signing hashes non-colliding?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): Transaction type signing hash collision prevention (legacy, EIP-2930, EIP-1559, EIP-4844, EIP-7702 type prefixes) is an execution layer concern. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement EL transaction signing or type disambiguation.

audit_items.title: Verify Conditional Scope: Pre-EIP-155 cross-chain replay vulnerability awareness
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): Pre-EIP-155 cross-chain replay protection and v-value validation (v == 27 or v == 28) are execution layer transaction validation features. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement EL transaction signing or chain ID validation.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does snapshot mechanism provide true deep-copy isolation?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): EVM state snapshot mechanism (copy_trie, deep-copy isolation for begin_transaction/rollback_transaction) is an execution layer state management feature. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement EVM state tries or snapshot isolation. No copy_trie, begin_transaction, or rollback_transaction found in Prysm.

audit_items.title: Is the snapshot count invariant maintained after begin_transaction?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): EVM state snapshot count invariant (len(state._snapshots) increment on begin_transaction) is an execution layer state management feature. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement EVM state snapshots.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does commit_transaction correctly decrement snapshot count?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): EVM state commit_transaction and snapshot count decrement are execution layer state management features. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement EVM state commit/rollback logic.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is created_accounts cleared only at outermost snapshot pop?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): created_accounts tracking and outermost snapshot pop logic are execution layer EVM state features (related to EIP-2200 gas accounting and EIP-6780 SELFDESTRUCT). Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement EVM account creation tracking.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does rollback_transaction restore exact snapshot state?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): EVM rollback_transaction and state restoration from snapshots (_main_trie, _storage_tries) are execution layer state management features. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement EVM state rollback.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is transient storage correctly restored after rollback?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): EIP-1153 transient storage (TSTORE/TLOAD) and its rollback semantics are execution layer EVM features. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement transient storage. No transient_storage references found in Prysm.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are persistent and transient snapshot stacks synchronized?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): Persistent and transient snapshot stack synchronization is an execution layer EVM state management concern. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement EVM snapshot stacks.

audit_items.title: Is get_account guaranteed to never return None?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): The get_account function and EMPTY_ACCOUNT sentinel value are execution layer EVM state management features. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement EVM account retrieval from state tries.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does set_account(None) preserve storage?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch (EL vs CL): The set_account function and storage trie preservation on account deletion are execution layer EVM state management features. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement EVM account or storage trie management.
